digest.component_or_area: LLM provider integration / OpenAI model target resolution
propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107 emits PydanticAIDeprecationWarning when rebar constructs OpenAI model targets using the ambiguous `openai:` prefix, because v2 will change that prefix from Chat Completions to Responses
rebar's _pai_model and model_classes._resolve_target both normalize inferred or legacy-explicit OpenAI targets to the ambiguous `openai:` qualifier, triggering the warning at runtime

ProviderSession's custom base_url builder registration and per-candidate endpoint-override guard only match the legacy bare `openai` provider name, so targets must resolve to that name to preserve endpoint injection and profile override behavior

Normalizing all rebar-owned inferred, configured, and legacy-explicit OpenAI targets to the explicit `openai-chat:` qualifier preserves Chat Completions semantics while eliminating the announced-v2 deprecation warning
Provider-resolution, custom-endpoint, fallback, and interface tests verify that normalized `openai-chat:` targets construct OpenAIChatModel without warning and route loopback endpoints correctly
